title: Meghalaya teachers’ agitation raises concerns over’ examinations

ai.summary: Meghalaya deficit teachers' strike has disrupted school exams, with 40 out of 44 teachers absent at St Anthony's Higher Secondary School. School management arranged invigilation with private teachers and non-teaching staff to continue exams.

facts.claim: 40 of the 44 deficit teachers remained absent due to the agitation
facts.quote: At St Anthony's, around 40 of the 44 deficit teachers remained absent due to the agitation.

facts.claim: School continued examinations by assigning invigilation duties to private teachers and non-teaching staff
facts.quote: the school continued examinations by assigning invigilation duties to private teachers and non-teaching staff.

ai.background_note: Meghalaya deficit teachers have been protesting since May 2026 over delayed appointments, leading to a strike that has affected school operations.
